title: Explicit bracketed finite triple-product coordinate maps
statement:
Fix a finite commutative coefficient ring A as in [def-pur-conventions]. On each scheme X, let D_A(X) be the ordinary unbounded derived category of constant-A module sheaves on the small pro-etale site, with K-flat tensor, derived inverse image Lf*, ordinary direct image Rf*, and exact open extension j! [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom, def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. An origin condition means the existing bounded-below etale-origin predicate, and retained witnesses mean the witnesses of [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness]. For a compactification c=(j,a) of f, write F_c=Ra* j! [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Write C(c,d)_M for the component at M of the normalized candidate comparison of [def-sf-origin-candidate-comparison].

Given a binary product geometry G with projections p,q on its open product and r,t on its ambient product [def-pc-fibre-product, def-pur-finite-product-compactification-data], define external_G(M,N)=Lp*M tensor Lq*N and externalMap(r,t;m,n)=(tensor.map(Lr*m)).app(Lt*N);(tensor.obj(Lr*M')).map(Lt*n). Use the specified binary open comparison e_G and chosen forward word xi_G, including exactly the projection/exchange maps of [def-exchange-projection], from [def-pur-finite-product-compactification-data], and the ordinary word Omega_G from [def-pur-finite-ordinary-product]. For an open j, let adj_j be the exact open-extension adjunction transported to the specified left-derived inverse image. For maps s:M→Lj*H and t:N→Lk*J in a binary geometry, define restrictPair_G(s,t) by externalMap(p,q;s,t), followed in each tensor variable by the inverse inverse-image compositor and the inverse commuting-triangle comparison, then by the inverse tensor comparison for the product open u [lem-pur-derived-pullback-tensor-iso]. Thus its target is Lu*(Lr*H tensor Lt*J); every compositor is the canonical one, with the two projection equalities supplied by G.

Given f_i:X_i→B and displayed compactifications c_i, define G12=geometry(c1,c2), G23=geometry(c2,c3), GL=geometry(compactification(G12),c3), and GR=geometry(c1,compactification(G23)). Define D12=external_G12(M1,M2), D23=external_G23(M2,M3), DL=external_GL(D12,M3), and DR=external_GR(M1,D23). Set H_i=j_i!M_i, E12=external ambient_G12(H1,H2) and E23=external ambient_G23(H2,H3). Define eL=externalMap(GL.r,GL.t;e_G12,id);e_GL and eR=externalMap(GR.r,GR.t;id,e_G23);e_GR. The binary restriction maps use restrictPair on the two open units. The left triple restriction uses restrictPair_GL on the binary restriction12 and the third unit, with ambient inputs E12,H3; the right one uses restrictPair_GR on the first unit and restriction23, with ambient inputs H1,E23.

For independent original compactifications o1,o2,o3,o12,o23,oL,oR, thetaL is (xi_G12 tensor id);xi_GL;C(oL,compactification(GL)) and thetaR is (id tensor xi_G23);xi_GR;C(oR,compactification(GR)), on their respective bracketed products. sourceL and sourceR are the corresponding bracketed tensor composites of C(oi,ci). ordinaryL is (Omega_G12 tensor id);Omega_GL;R(GL.t;c3.g)*(eL), and ordinaryR is (id tensor Omega_G23);Omega_GR;R(GR.t;compactification(G23).g)*(eR). Equations is the conjunction IsIso(eL), IsIso(eR), restrictionL;LuL*(eL)=unit_DL, restrictionR;LuR*(eR)=unit_DR, thetaL=sourceL;ordinaryL, thetaR=sourceR;ordinaryR. FiniteTripleProductNormalForms universally quantifies these choices with exactly the separated finite-type scheme hypotheses over the fixed field [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], the three retained D+ origin witnesses, the two source tensor-origin hypotheses, and all four six-object binary tensor-domain predicates from [def-pur-finite-product-compactification-data]. This is a definition of the assertion, not a proof of any of its clauses.

source.place: Clause (ii), the compactification reduction; the binary pasting and naturality calculations in Steps 2--4 of lem-pur-finite-triple-product-normal-forms.

mathlib_searches.query: Iterated external tensor products of compactly supported derived sheaves agree with proper product compactifications
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits on light condensed monoidal categories and sheaf tensor; none gives either the specified binary open-unit equation or the ordinary product word naturality.

mathlib_searches.query: The naturality of the ordinary derived sheaf product and the unit normalization of a binary extension by zero tensor comparison
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits: CartesianMonoidalCategory product comparisons, toSheafify naturality, mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor and toRightDerivedZero; none states the specified binary equation.

Mathlib search finds only transfinite restriction names. Local source search finds the binary constructions in FiniteProductCompactification and the recursive restriction in FiniteTripleProductNormalForms, without either claimed compatibility theorem.

def FiniteTripleProductNormalForms (C : WeilConjectures.PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    {B X₁ X₂ X₃ : Scheme.{u}}
    [B.Over (Spec (.of C.field.k))] [X₁.Over (Spec (.of C.field.k))]
    [X₂.Over (Spec (.of C.field.k))] [X₃.Over (Spec (.of C.field.k))]
    [IsSeparated (B ↘ Spec (.of C.field.k))]
    [IsSeparated (X₁ ↘ Spec (.of C.field.k))]
    [IsSeparated (X₂ ↘ Spec (.of C.field.k))]
    [IsSeparated (X₃ ↘ Spec (.of C.field.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (B ↘ Spec (.of C.field.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X₁ ↘ Spec (.of C.field.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X₂ ↘ Spec (.of C.field.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X₃ ↘ Spec (.of C.field.k))]
    [QuasiCompact (B ↘ Spec (.of C.field.k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X₁ ↘ Spec (.of C.field.k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X₂ ↘ Spec (.of C.field.k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X₃ ↘ Spec (.of C.field.k))]
    (f₁ : X₁ ⟶ B) (f₂ : X₂ ⟶ B) (f₃ : X₃ ⟶ B)
    [f₁.IsOver (Spec (.of C.field.k))] [f₂.IsOver (Spec (.of C.field.k))]
    [f₃.IsOver (Spec (.of C.field.k))]
    [IsSeparated f₁] [LocallyOfFiniteType f₁] [QuasiCompact f₁]
    [IsSeparated f₂] [LocallyOfFiniteType f₂] [QuasiCompact f₂]
    [IsSeparated f₃] [LocallyOfFiniteType f₃] [QuasiCompact f₃]
    (M₁ : _root_.DerivedCategory.Plus
      (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X₁) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} C.Coefficient)))
    (M₂ : _root_.DerivedCategory.Plus
      (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X₂) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} C.Coefficient)))
    (M₃ : _root_.DerivedCategory.Plus
      (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X₃) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} C.Coefficient)))
    (w₁ : Scheme.FixedEtaleOriginWitness X₁ C.Coefficient M₁)
    (w₂ : Scheme.FixedEtaleOriginWitness X₂ C.Coefficient M₂)
    (w₃ : Scheme.FixedEtaleOriginWitness X₃ C.Coefficient M₃) : Prop
